summary:

Two tracks this week (Mon Oct 9 – Sun Oct 15) have the climbing icon:
- "More tired than usual today" (yesterday): 50 minutes
- "Lunch Break Fitness" (Monday): 40 minutes

None of the other tracks this week have the climbing icon. I submitted 90 and ended the episode.
